summary.headline: Eureka Forbes Q1 FY27 revenue rose 15.3% YoY to INR701 crore, but adjusted EBITDA margin fell 46 bps to 10.5% on a 131 bps gross margin drop.
summary.overview: Revenue grew 15.3% YoY to INR701 crore, led by water purifiers (high-teens growth on double-digit volume growth) with broad-based strength across retail, direct and e-commerce. Adjusted EBITDA rose 10.5% to INR74 crore, but margin slipped 46 bps to 10.5% as gross margin fell 131 bps to 58.4% and A&SP spend was front-loaded. Service revenue growth was similar to Q4 FY26, while AMC bookings softened after price increases of roughly 3% to 12%. Management guided to a clear step-up in full-year growth and to FY27 EBITDA margins broadly in line with FY26.

financial_highlights.change: +44% YoY; includes one-time INR19.5 crore gratuity reversal gain

segments.name: Water purifiers
segments.commentary: Grew high-teens on double-digit volume growth, with market share gains driven by economy range, stainless steel range, and premium Hot/UTC/IoT models. Management says growth was ahead of the category.

segments.name: Product business (overall)
segments.commentary: Grew late teens, broad-based across retail, direct and e-commerce, each with strong double-digit growth.

segments.name: Emerging categories (robotics, softeners, air purifiers)
segments.commentary: Strong growth across all emerging categories; robotics driven by premium mix (fully automatic cleaning station), softeners by volume. Robotics campaign launched with Shraddha Kapoor.

segments.name: Service (AMC and filters)
segments.commentary: Revenue growth similar to Q4 FY26 levels, but AMC bookings growth moderated after price increases; filter portfolio grew well. Filter gross margin is slightly below AMC but still high.

guidance_outlook: Clear step-up in FY27 full-year growth expected, supported by strong Q1 start.
FY27 full-year EBITDA margin aimed to be broadly in line with FY26 (FY26 exited with ~55 bps expansion).
Service revenue growth in Q2 FY27 expected to be similar to Q1; beyond that depends on AMC bookings and filter scale-up.
A&SP spend expected to grow ahead of revenue growth in FY27, focused on in-store presence and consumer finance.
ESOP expense expected at INR25-26 crore for FY27.
FY30 ambition reiterated: 2x revenue vs FY25 and 3x EBITDA; robotics targeted at INR1,000 crore by FY30.
Price increases to be calibrated; no plan for further consumer price hikes while momentum holds.
capex_capacity: The call gave no capex figures, capacity or utilisation numbers, or commissioning timelines for any plant or facility.
Management described the net cash surplus of INR425 crore and said it will invest selectively in areas that support long-term growth, but did not specify amounts or projects.
Robotics is targeted at INR1,000 crore business by FY30, with the service network strengthened to support robotics; no investment amount or timeline was specified.
A&SP spend is to grow ahead of revenue in FY27, directed at in-store presence (sales promoters) and consumer finance adoption; no absolute figure was given.
ESOP expense is expected at INR25-26 crore for FY27, linked to fresh grants and expanded coverage.
demand_pricing: Water purifier category penetration about 7%; high perceived cost of ownership cited as key barrier.
Price increases in products taken at start of quarter; peers followed with about a 30-day lag, and price parity now restored.
AMC price increases in the 3% to 12% band (single-year vs multi-year) led to deferred AMC renewals and softer bookings.
Four-year filter-life water purifiers (Glow 4X at ~INR22,000, Ritz Pro 4X at ~INR25,000) launched in e-commerce about 45 days before the call; competitors followed more recently.
Simplified filter range cut from ~65 SKUs to five universal filters; filter awareness campaigns stepped up.
Management says no supply-side help from competitors' disruptions; market share gains attributed to own initiatives and point-of-sale investment.

qa_highlights.question: Why is service growth not picking up despite pricing, and when will it reach double digits?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said service revenue grew in line with Q4 FY26 levels; AMC bookings were deferred by customers after the 3-12% price hike, with an 18-month AMC tenure creating a lag into revenue. Filters are being used to offset.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the 15% growth came from pricing?
qa_highlights.answer: Growth was mainly volume-led for water and softeners, while robotics growth came from premium mix. Pricing had some impact in water; management did not quantify it.

qa_highlights.question: Will the service liability (deferred revenue) help FY27 service growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes, it helps FY27 revenue. However, in-year bookings must sustain growth, and the softness in AMC bookings is expected to show more in the later part of the year. Q2 service growth is expected to be similar to Q1.

qa_highlights.question: How will margins be maintained in FY27 with A&SP rising faster than revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Q1 margin decline reflects upfronted growth investment. Management cited COGS and opex efficiency workstreams and operating leverage, with the aim to hold FY26 margins; it noted FY26 ended with ~55 bps expansion after a similar Q1.

qa_highlights.question: Could the company reverse price hikes if commodity costs fall?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said that if costs correct, it would pass benefits to consumers to stay competitive and grow share, rather than retain them.

qa_highlights.question: Does the 2x revenue ambition by FY30 hold for products vs services?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects products and emerging categories to grow faster than services, with filters growing ahead of AMC. It reaffirmed 2x revenue vs FY25 (about 17-18% CAGR) and 3x EBITDA by FY30.

risks_watch: Gross margin pressure from commodity and forex; management says no meaningful input cost relief yet.
AMC bookings softness after price hike may weigh on service revenue in H2 FY27.
A&SP rising ahead of revenue growth; margin hold depends on cost programmes.
Increasing competition from new entrants and 3-4 year filter-life offers from peers.
Ongoing geopolitical crisis and currency volatility.
Q1 PAT growth of 44% is flattered by INR19.5 crore one-time gratuity reversal; underlying PAT grew 6.1%.
summary.management_tone: Confident on product growth and market share, but cautious on margins and service bookings. Management repeatedly flagged the year as "extremely unusual" due to commodity, forex and geopolitical pressure, and was evasive on the exact A&SP split and service growth targets.
key_quotes: I'm pleased to share that we delivered a solid start to FY27.
we expect full year EBITDA margins to be broadly in line with last year.
We have, as you're aware, a number of initiatives going on driving our service revenue.

growth.why: Management guides to a clear step-up in FY27 full-year growth backed by a strong Q1 start (revenue +15.3%), but no capacity, orders or contracts with numbers were given, so backing is vague; full-year EBITDA margin held broadly in line with FY26.
